name: Hangzhou Lion Electronics Co.,Ltd
summary: Hangzhou Lion Electronics Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of semiconductor silicon wafers and power devices, and compound semiconductor radio frequency chips in China and internationally. The company offers semiconductor silicon polished and epitaxial wafers; Schottky diode (SBD), fast recovery diode (FRD), metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (MOSFET), transient suppression diode (TVS), insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT), gallium arsenide (GaAs) RF, and vertical cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL) chips. Its products are used in terminal application fields, including 5G communications, automotive electronics, photovoltaic industry, …
